WordPress.org Plugin Backdoor Campaign

Campaign: wordpress-plugin-backdoor-2024
Date: 2024-06-21 to 2024-06-24 (3 days)
Actor: Third Party (group)
Impact: account_takeover, defacement

Synopsis

The June 2024 WordPress.org plugin campaign inserted backdoors into several established plugins through the official plugin distribution channel. Malicious updates created unauthorized administrator accounts and injected footer JavaScript for spam and control, turning routine plugin upgrades into site takeover paths. The campaign is grouped separately from vendor-hosted WordPress compromises because the affected packages shared the same registry venue, timing, behavior, and plugin-scope impact.
